# Psalm 44 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Of-the-sons of-Korah. A-Maskil.

**2** O-God, with-our-ears we-have-heard, our-fathers have-told-us, the-deeds You-did in-their-days, in-days of-old.

**3** You — Your-hand drove-out the-nations, and-You-planted-them [our fathers]; You-afflicted the-peoples, and-You-sent-them-out.

**4** For not by-their-sword they-possessed the-land, and-their-arm did-not save-them; but Your-right-hand and-Your-arm and-the-light of-Your-face, for You-favored-them.

**5** You [are] my-King, O-God; command the-salvations of-Jacob.

**6** Through-You we-push-down our-adversaries; through-Your-name we-trample those-rising against-us.

**7** For not in-my-bow do-I-trust, and-my-sword does-not save-me.

**8** For You-have-saved-us from-our-adversaries, and-those-hating-us You-have-put-to-shame.

**9** In-God we-boast all the-day, and-Your-name forever we-praise. Selah.

**10** Yet You-have-rejected and-humiliated-us, and-You-do-not go-out with-our-armies.

**11** You-make-us turn-back from-the-adversary, and-those-hating-us plunder for-themselves.

**12** You-give-us like-sheep [for] food, and-among the-nations You-have-scattered-us.

**13** You-sell Your-people for-no-wealth, and-You-did-not increase [the price] by-their-sale-price.

**14** You-make-us a-reproach to-our-neighbors, a-scorn and-derision to-those-around-us.

**15** You-make-us a-byword among-the-nations, a-shaking of-the-head among-the-peoples.

**16** All the-day my-disgrace [is] before-me, and-the-shame of-my-face covers-me,

**17** because-of the-voice of-the-taunter and-the-reviler, because-of the-face of-the-enemy and-the-avenger.

**18** All this has-come upon-us, but-we-have-not forgotten-You, and-we-have-not been-false to-Your-covenant.

**19** Our-heart has-not turned-back, and-our-steps have-not departed from-Your-path,

**20** though You-have-crushed-us in-a-place of-jackals and-covered-us with-the-shadow of-death.

**21** If we-had-forgotten the-name of-our-God, and-spread-out our-hands to-a-foreign god,

**22** would-not God search-this-out? For He knows the-secrets of-the-heart.

**23** For on-Your-account we-are-killed all the-day; we-are-regarded as-sheep of-slaughter.

**24** Awake! Why do-You-sleep, Lord? Arise! Do-not reject [us] forever!

**25** Why do-You-hide Your-face? [Why] do-You-forget our-affliction and-our-oppression?

**26** For our-soul is-bowed-down to-the-dust; our-belly clings to-the-ground.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **44:23**: Paul quotes this verse in Romans 8:36 — 'For Your sake we are killed all the day long' — applying Israel's suffering to Christian persecution.

— EMET
